content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling newly built homes and title or mortgage services; no lease-to-own or consumer merchandise business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder and build-to-rent landlord; different products, customers and business model from lease-to-own merchandise access."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family homes and townhomes with mortgage services; unrelated to rent-to-own merchandise."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Pawn lending and used merchandise resale; secured loans differ from lease-to-own access to new goods."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Restaurants, liquor stores and franchising in South Florida; different products and business entirely."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retailer selling groceries to households; no lease-purchase financing or rent-to-own model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder with mortgage and insurance services for homebuyers; different products and customers from the target."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"B2B AI lending platform connecting banks and investors; does not run lease-to-own stores or merchandise access."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Buys and collects charged-off consumer debt; collections business differs from lease-to-own retail and financing."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Provides lease-to-own payment plans for furniture, electronics and appliances to credit-limited consumers via retail partners, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Self-storage facility owner renting space to consumers; a real estate rental business with no merchandise leasing."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings retailer selling outright to households; no lease-to-own financing or rent-to-own model."}]}
